# Map panel — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the map panel when a selected map feature needs its card: the anchored card surface around a required title. `position` picks the shape — floating card or a docked edge sheet — while the host does the anchoring, and `media`, `meta`, `actions` and `footer` slot the regions around the title: route preview or photo above the text, the host status pill for feature state, primary actions, and secondary lines like arrival estimates. `title` is required because every floating surface must be nameable, and `onClose` is the close action behind the dismiss control — omit it and no dismiss renders. There is no map inside and no feature fetching: title, description and slots arrive as props and the panel never loads.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the map panel when a selected map feature needs its card: the anchored card surface around a required title — the native twin under the same contract. `position` picks the shape — floating card or a docked edge sheet — while the host does the anchoring, and `media`, `meta`, `actions` and `footer` slot the regions around the title: route preview or photo above the text, the host status pill for feature state, primary actions, and secondary lines like arrival estimates. `title` is required because every floating surface must be nameable — it is the accessible name on this renderer — and `onClose` is the close action behind the labelled close control. There is no map inside and no feature fetching: title, description and slots arrive as props and the panel never loads.
